content.originalText:
User-requested deeper proposal; correlation RUNTIME_ROLE_PROPOSAL_20261020, extends the existing DIR_TOPOLOGY_20261020 directory/repo-consolidation scope rather than creating a duplicate by default. User wants an interview-driven proposal defining the VPS Host vs herdr-runtime responsibilities, for the successor Orchestrator to adopt via common-harness IDs and related work. Actual interview answer so far: retain BOTH host and container with explicit purpose separation; other role/storage answers are pending. No migration/deletion/restart is authorized by this proposal drafting task.

Important correction from read-only source audit: /docker/herdr-runtime/deployment/README.md already defines dedicated SSH+Herdr+Codex remote USER runtime (palantirkc UID1000), isolated from Hermes, hostroot/Tailscale as jump endpoint. Problem is declared design versus actual root-host-centered use, canonical source/working-copy ownership, entrypoint and session-context ambiguity. healthy currently checks SSH readiness; only tini/supervisord/sshd are running, so absence of Herdr is compatible with intended cold-readiness. Host root nativeCLI installations do not provision the container. Container helper codex-herdr explicitly uses codex --no-daemon to preserve pane context; generic codex/herdr-agent-start may need explicit launch semantics. Source Compose includes stdin overlay provenance to reconcile before rebuilding.

I will prepare a bounded typed proposal/evidence/interview package under host /home/palantirkc/operations (staging only, not a new authoritative Work/Memory store), preserving facts versus user choices versus recommendations and excluding credentials/user-data contents. Please provide the actual existing logical Task/Work IDs, canonical source-owned handoff entrypoint and admission/update command contract for this scope at a natural checkpoint. If not yet registered, register/extend it using the existing common harness and make successor ownership explicit. Do not infer a selected architecture before interview answers. Include prior hermes-profile-* repo consolidation requirement and existing owner/effect fences; retain native roles and pending old-Lead-only conditional Pause instruction unchanged. Reply RUNTIME_ROLE_PROPOSAL_20261020_REPLY with IDs and canonical locators only; no transcript restatement.
content.actualInterviewAnswer: Retain BOTH VPS Host and herdr-runtime with explicit purpose separation.
content.attribution: Actual user request relay and actual interview answer supplied to current MAIN. Source-audit observations remain attributed source statements, not new helper runtime probes.
content.priorStructuralConsolidationAuthority: Prior actual successor-owned source planning/consolidation authority in ODI-DECISION-DIR-TOPOLOGY-STRUCTURAL-CONSOLIDATION-20261020 remains separate and guarded. This runtime-role proposal drafting grants no additional migration/deletion/restart permission.
